title: Fortran constitutive runtime-cost screen
question: Does the adaptive lookup remain computationally attractive after paying nonuniform interval search and transformed-value reconstruction costs in optimized Fortran?

benchmark_policy.interpretation: screen only; end-to-end Richards runtime remains required

decision_rule: Do not advance a representation solely because it uses fewer support points. Advance only candidates whose measured optimized-Fortran evaluation cost is competitive with direct analytical evaluation and whose constitutive screen remains PASS.
